svg.title: Attention: input and output projections
svg.desc: The same 3×8 input is projected with three different 8×8 weights into Q, K and V, each of shape 3×8. The internal computation of Core Attention is omitted. The Attention result H is projected with Wo to produce Y of shape 3×8.
svg.text: MHA · T = 3 tokens · model dimension d = 8

g.text: Create Q, K and V from one input, then transform the Attention result.
We will explore the computation in the next article.
This output is added to the residual stream at the same positions.

svg.text: Q, K, V and the Attention result all have shape T × d.
